newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary agrees asset return deal with Vatican.
newsitem.headline: Hungary agrees asset return deal with Vatican.

text.p: Hungary is to hand over real estate and payments worth nearly 150 billion forints ($830.2 million) to the Vatican, after reaching an accord on Thursday over church assets confiscated by the communist regime after World War Two.
"We have signed an historic agreement with the Holy See about financing the catholic church and meeting their real estate claims," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference.
Kiss said the agreement was a compromise between Hungary's financial position and the Vatican's claims.

Under the accord, Hungary will return the larger part of real estate worth more than 100 billion forints by 2011, while some 42 billion forints of the total claims will be satisfied in the form of annual payments to the church.
Hungary also pledged to grant educational institutions maintained by the Catholic church the same subsidies as schools and universities supervised by the state.
